links.outcome: ChatGPT triage accuracy versus ED physicians against consultant gold standard
links.effect: ChatGPT agreed with ED physicians 85.61% (κ=0.780) but accuracy versus consultant was 42.86%; physician-consultant agreement was 63.9% (κ=0.406).
links.quote: ChatGPT's accuracy compared to the consultant was 42.86%, with slight reliability, showing a tendency to overestimate acuity, particularly in critical cases.

screen.reason: Prospective observational study evaluating the safety and accuracy of ChatGPT for triage scoring in an emergency department using real patient presentations.
